activity_statements.statement: operates a unified air-ground express package delivery network (Federal Express segment) serving businesses and consumers worldwide
provides less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation services for commercial shippers through FedEx Freight
delivers 9.9 million packages per day across 220+ countries and territories
offers e-commerce fulfillment solutions, customs brokerage, and global freight forwarding through FedEx Logistics
operates retail shipping centers (FedEx Office) providing document services and package drop-off access points for consumers and businesses
employs package handlers, drivers, pilots, maintenance technicians and facility operations staff across a 500,000+ person global workforce
develops digital logistics solutions through FedEx Dataworks to transform customer and team-member digital experiences

name_reality_gap: The FedEx name accurately signals package and freight delivery; however, the firm is also a significant LTL trucking operator, a customs brokerage, and an emerging digital-logistics software business — categories obscured by the express-delivery brand identity.
extraction_notes: FedEx main website pages blocked (permission errors). Used careers page and 10-K excerpt retrieved via ExaSearch. FedEx completed One FedEx consolidation on June 1, 2024: Ground merged into Federal Express. Two reportable segments from FY2025: Federal Express and FedEx Freight.
